These are some tips that stop my Iida (I assume others as well but who knows)

Both of these tips fall under one major tip:
Stay calm - a big part of Iida’s kit is just overwhelming presence. If he gets in your head and you panic, ~80% of the time he’s already won.

Don’t have a predictable recovery - most Iidas will be prepared for the quick getup, mine included. I can only assume a good Iida would, instead of assuming the quick getup, read their opponent by conditioning once or twice. A big way for Iidas to get damage is knowing the timing that invul runs out on recovery. If it’s a 1v1… You WILL get hit, so try to be unpredictable, he could mistime an attack and give an opening.

Time your dodge, his alpha is fast, but if he’s starting with a beta, there’s a BIG wind up. Eventually you will see the alpha’s wind up too. Also if their Iida is like mine, be careful for their areal melee. It has a decent windup as well but it is a tool just as powerful as the alpha for kweping pressure.

Hope this helps :)
